title: Cocoa Cookies
description: Vegan, sugar-free cookies made from ripe bananas, cocoa powder and almond butter. Rich and bittersweet with a texture between a biscuit and a brownie.
steps: Mash the bananas in a bowl using a fork. In a separate bowl, mix together the cocoa powder and almond butter.
Add the bananas to the cocoa mixture a spoonful at a time and gradually blend into a thick dough.
Lay a sheet of cling film on a flat surface and place the dough on top. Wrap and roll into a cylinder around 5cm in diameter. Place flat in the freezer for 25 minutes to harden.
Remove the cylinder from the freezer, remove the cling film, and use a serrated knife to slice into 1cm discs.
Space the cookies out on a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper and bake for around 20 minutes or until they begin to crisp up.
Transfer to a wire rack and allow to cool completely before eating — they will harden as they cool.
notes: Makes 16 cookies. Per cookie estimate. Dust with icing sugar to make them look smarter.
